arml-2019-relay-1-1.title: Perfect square numerator
arml-2019-relay-1-1.body:
The numerator is $(a+b+c)^2$, so the expression equals $a+b+c=60$.

**Answer: 60**

arml-2019-relay-1-2.title: Unit conversion
arml-2019-relay-1-2.body:
*(In the relay, $T$ was the answer to the previous problem, 60.)*


One lap takes $5\cdot20.19=100.95$ seconds, so $T$ laps take $\frac{100.95\,T}{60}$ minutes. With $T=60$ this is $100.95$ minutes, which rounds to $101$.

**Answer: 101**

arml-2019-relay-1-3.title: Along the altitude
arml-2019-relay-1-3.body:
*(In the relay, $T$ was the answer to the previous problem, 101.)*


By symmetry the line $COP$ is the angle bisector of $C$, which is also the altitude $CH$ to the hypotenuse. Then $CH=CO+OP+PH=r\sqrt2+2r+r=(3+\sqrt2)r$. Also $CH=\frac{AC}{\sqrt2}=\frac{\sqrt{98}}{\sqrt2}=7$. So $r=\frac7{3+\sqrt2}=\frac{7(3-\sqrt2)}{7}=3-\sqrt2$.

**Answer: $3-\sqrt2$**

arml-2019-relay-2-2.title: Two equations
arml-2019-relay-2-2.body:
*(In the relay, $T$ was the answer to the previous problem, 67.)*


Let there be $x$ children and $y$ adults paying $a$ dollars each. Then $5x+ay=10T$ and $5x+1.2ay=11T$. Subtracting, $0.2ay=T$, so $ay=5T$, and $5x=5T$: $x=T=67$.

**Answer: 67**

arml-2019-relay-2-3.title: A strip inside a triangle
arml-2019-relay-2-3.body:
*(In the relay, $T$ was the answer to the previous problem, 67.)*


$FK$ is a diagonal of $FAKE$, with $FK=\frac{5T}3$, and a side of $FUNK$, whose other side is $UF=\frac{12}5$. Take $U,N$ on the same side of $FK$ as $A$. The intersection is the part of right triangle $FAK$ (area $\frac{2T^2}3$, altitude to $FK$ equal to $\frac{4T}5$) within distance $\frac{12}5$ of $FK$.

For $T=67$, $\frac{12}5<\frac{4T}5$, so we remove from triangle $FAK$ the similar triangle at $A$ with altitude $\frac{4T}5-\frac{12}5$:
$$\frac{2T^2}3\left(1-\left(\frac{T-3}T\right)^2\right)=\frac23\left(T^2-(T-3)^2\right)=4T-6=262.$$
(Equivalently: the strip $\frac{5T}3\times\frac{12}5=4T$ minus two corner triangles of total area $\frac12\cdot\frac{12}5\left(\frac{16}5+\frac95\right)=6$.)

**Answer: 262**
